requirements.requirement: The system must define a structured explainability schema object containing measure_id, raw_value, normalized_score, weight, and contribution_to_final_score.
The system must implement the explainability schema as a typed model (e.g., Pydantic) to enforce field presence and data types at runtime.
The system must ensure measure_id is represented as a non-empty string identifier.
The system must ensure raw_value accepts numeric or null values to support missing data scenarios.
The system must ensure normalized_score is a numeric value constrained between 0 and 1 inclusive.
The system must ensure weight is a numeric value greater than or equal to 0.
The system must ensure contribution_to_final_score is a numeric value representing the weighted contribution of the measure.
The system must support serialization of the explainability schema into JSON compatible with existing facade response formats.
The system must allow the explainability schema to be composed as a list of measure-level objects within a parent response payload.
The system must integrate the schema definition into the evaluate_care_facade response composition without breaking existing response fields.
The system must validate that all required fields are present when constructing an explainability object and reject incomplete objects.
The system must return a validation error if normalized_score is outside the range [0,1].
The system must default raw_value to null when source data is missing rather than omitting the field.
The system must ensure backward compatibility by allowing existing facade consumers to ignore the explainability field without failure.
The system must raise a schema validation error if measure_id is missing or empty.
The system must support deterministic field naming and ordering to ensure consistent downstream parsing.
